_help: Gas and Unit Converter. Units: decimals of each unit compared with the smallest one. Actions: typical gas used by common EVM actions (rough, they vary by contract and chain: review). Solana: the base fee per signature in lamports. Defaults fill the form the first time.

actions.label: Send ETH
actions.note: A plain ETH transfer always uses 21,000 gas.

actions.label: Send a token
actions.note: A token (ERC-20) transfer is often around 45,000 to 65,000 gas.

actions.label: Swap on a DEX
actions.note: Swaps often use 100,000 to 200,000 gas, more with complex routes.

actions.label: Mint an NFT
actions.note: NFT mints vary a lot by contract, often 80,000 to 200,000 gas.

line: Fees here are estimates from the numbers you type. Your wallet shows the real fee before you confirm. On many layer 2 chains there is also a small data fee not shown here.
